content:
Morgan: Kicking off bring-up for equinox8b (Mistral-ish arch) with int4 profile A. Quick note: calibration looked fine but generation shows a soft token flicker after ~128 tokens.
Rachel: Can you paste the quant command and the qconfig?
Morgan: Sure:
```
quantize --model equinox8b.pt --dtype int4 --scheme perhead_static --clip 0.95 --calib-batches 500
```
Morgan: Observed that flipping head-dim grouping from 32->16 reduces flicker but increases ppl slightly. Suspect a headwise scale mismatch with rotary sin/cos basis.
Igor: Do you see any pattern by head index? i.e., every Nth head bad?
Morgan: Yes, heads 2,5,8... pattern every 3 heads. Dumped a tiny diff of rotary weights after quantization:
```
head 2 max_delta 3.2e-2
head 3 max_delta 6.1e-3
head 5 max_delta 2.8e-2
```
Sam: That smells like our head-split packing bug (we had a reorder when padding for int4 lanes). Did you run the packer with "preserve-order=true"?
Morgan: No, default was used. Re-ran with preserve-order true, flicker reduced but not gone. Still seeing vocab-adjacent artifacts — certain accented tokens jump probability.
Devon: Reminds me of the unicode normalization mismatch we saw with zephyr. Could be tokenizer mapping; any token ids that changed between the float and quant workflow?
Morgan: Good call. I compared token ids for sample offending tokens, they match. But embedding lookup outputs shifted by small amount after quantize+pack.
Rachel: Can you share a minimized repro? short conv that shows the token jump (input + logits).
Morgan: Pasted below — very minimal:
```
input: "Café in the morning"
float logits for token 'é' : -1.2
int4 logits for token 'é'   : 0.3
```
Igor: Oof. That delta is huge. Could be illegal casting in embedding transpose or a stride mismatch. Check the export order (proj_out vs proj_in) in the converter.
Sam: Also confirm rotary/freq scaling not accidentally quantized separately. We usually keep rotary params in fp16 in other conversions.
quant-bot: NOTE: running a background compare job between float32 and int4 for equinox8b on perf-worker-3, ETA 22m.
Morgan: Thanks. I'll try preserving original head packing, keep rotary params fp16, and re-run. Will post updates.
Rachel: If the compare shows weight reorder, ping @Igor and I can bisect the converter commit range.
Morgan: Update: re-run with preserve-order + rotary fp16 fixed most cases; remaining flicker limited to long-context (>512) under continuous sampling. Looks like KV cache indexwrap interacting with tokenpad. Will open a small PR with test and a dump.
Sam: Nice. Add a regression test under quant-smoke that verifies top-5 token stability after quant vs float on that sample.
Morgan: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
